historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's 2009 survey of Japantown as a large-scale Brutalist apartment block and tower, of the kind redevelopment put along the Geary Boulevard corridor in the 1960s and 1970s.
The Sequoias Retirement Community, designed by Silvio Marraccini of Stone, Mulloy & Marraccini in the Late Modern style.

"The Sequoias", 1969: a twenty-five-storey, three-hundred-unit senior housing complex on Cathedral Hill by Stone, Marraccini & Patterson, clad in pre-cast concrete of smooth, raked and coarse textures.

unknowns: The city's two surveys of this building disagree about its style: the 2009 Japantown survey calls it Brutalist, the 2024 citywide statement on large apartment buildings calls it Late Modern.
